newsitem.title: USA: ALLTEL bids for PCS licenses in 73 markets.
newsitem.headline: ALLTEL bids for PCS licenses in 73 markets.

text.p: ALLTEL Corp said on Tuesday that it has bid $144 million for personal communications services licenses for 73 markets in 12 states at an auction held by the Federal Communications Commission.
ALLTEL said its total of potential wireless customers increased to 31.4 million from 8.4 million when the licenses are issued.
The new licenses extend ALLTEL's presence from Kansas City, Missouri, to Sherman, Texas and Northern Florida to North Carolina, ALLTEL said.
ALLTEL said major markets where it successfully bid for licenses include Kansas City; Atlanta; Jacksonville, Fla.; Memphis; Oklahoma City; Biloxi, Miss.; and Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina.
